contexts.text: A certain Spirit came to me from an infernal chamber which is towards the left side...

To the left in front there is a certain chamber where there is... mere darkness, wherefore it is called the dark chamber... In that chamber they plot... how to take people in; they call the darkness there deliciousness...
Many Heavens, to which correspond the various things which are in the chambers of the eye.
(The Council which invented the distinction between the Lord's two natures) assembled in a dark chamber.
These seemed to themselves to be sitting in a chamber and consulting together; these too are malicious...
Represented by a man and a woman in a chamber...
Windows at the sides according to the number of the mansions or chambers...
In the habitations of the Angels there are cellars, saloons, and bedchambers, in great numbers.
They who have delighted in... deceit are also in these vaults, and enter chambers so dark that they cannot even see each other...
The modest maidens who were seen in a chamber close by, signified affections of truth. AR 255. TCR 277. See SE 3605.a.
For this reason everyone in the Spiritual World knows the character of another as soon as he comes into his chamber.
(Melancthon) told me that at the back of the house there was a chamber adjoining his own, containing three tables, at which were seated persons of a like character with himself...
To the left there is a dark chamber...
These virgin Spirits... began to burn with desire to return into their chambers...
There appeared a dark chamber...
He was represented as dwelling in a long chamber as it were arched over, and of a green colour...
Presently they were introduced into a dark chamber...
On an infernal crew in a dark chamber. SE 1257. SE 1259:end.
I saw a habitation rather deep down... where there was a large room containing utensils...
On a dark infernal chamber. SE 4720.
